async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Byte Blaze' link that is likely the user profile link
    # Use filter to select the link with exact name 'Byte Blaze' and url '/byteblaze'
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Byte Blaze", exact=True).first.click()
    # Wait for navigation to the user profile page
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # On the user profile page, look for the status setting
    # Typically, there might be an 'Edit profile' button or link
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("link", name="Edit profile").click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    except:
        # If not found, try to find the status input directly
        pass
    # Look for the status input field; it might be a textbox with label 'Status' or similar
    await page.get_by_label("Status").fill("Playing Badminton")
    # Find and click the save button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes").click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Return a confirmation message
    return "Status set to Playing Badminton"
